notes: The representative multi-item sample uses a frozen audit-plan assembled from retained single-item S0F-1B/P5 audit outputs, because the aggregate live lifecycle-audit path for this target set was already known to be operationally unstable during parent-relationship lookup.

The preview-only sample still proves the intended P1 boundary: one multi-item manifest can retain per-target audit state, produce one pre-gate decision, and emit one remediation plan plus one compatible downstream issue-conclusion manifest without performing any live mutation.
All three sample items stop at pre-gate with stop-for-remediation, so P1 retains the planning surface only and deliberately does not cross into guarded apply.
